title: Quick Fix Chinese Boudin-Blanc Bowl
description: Quick and easy Chinese-inspired bowl dish featuring boudin blanc in a stone bowl. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat a large stone bowl in the oven at 400°F (200°C) for 10 minutes.
Rice a large boudin blanc log and slice it thinly.
Arrange the sliced mushrooms in the preheated stone bowl.
Add the sliced boudin blanc on top of the mushrooms.
Pour the sesame oil, soy sauce, and coconut aminos over the boudin blanc.
Add the chopped scallions and cilantro on top.
Grill the chicken breast in a separate pan until cooked through.
Slice the grilled chicken breast into thin strips and arrange on top of the boudin blanc bowl.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
Serve over cauliflower rice or zucchini noodles for a paleo-friendly option.
